context: Tests whether the agent reverse-engineers a small Express.js + Prisma codebase into the three required AIUP artifacts (use case diagram, per-use-case specs, entity model), follows the aggregation principle rather than generating one use case per endpoint, derives actors from authentication/authorization config, skips infrastructure endpoints, applies AIUP vocabulary to the entity model, and cross-validates the artifacts.

checklist.name: All three artifacts
checklist.description: All three artifact types are present: docs/requirements.md, at least one docs/use_cases/UC-XXX-*.md file, and docs/entity_model.md

checklist.name: No /health use case
checklist.description: The /health endpoint is not represented in the embedded Mermaid diagram or a spec file

checklist.name: Aggregated use cases
checklist.description: Total number of use case spec files is 8 or fewer — does NOT create one file per HTTP endpoint (codebase has 11+ route handlers)

checklist.name: Two actors identified
checklist.description: The embedded Mermaid diagram declares at least two distinct actors derived from auth middleware and role checks

checklist.name: Canonical Mermaid section
checklist.description: docs/requirements.md contains exactly one ## Use Case Diagram heading with one fenced mermaid block using graph LR

checklist.name: UC IDs in diagram
checklist.description: Every usecase block in the diagram includes a UC-XXX ID (three-digit, e.g. UC-001)

checklist.name: Spec files match diagram
checklist.description: Every UC-XXX ID in the embedded Mermaid diagram has a corresponding docs/use_cases/UC-XXX-*.md file

checklist.name: Business-level steps
checklist.description: Use case spec steps do NOT contain HTTP verbs (POST, GET, PUT, DELETE), route paths (/orders, /auth/login), or ORM/framework method names (prisma.*, router.*, await)

checklist.name: Alternative flows present
checklist.description: At least three use case spec files each contain at least one Alternative Flow section with a Trigger referencing a numbered main-scenario step

checklist.name: Entity model ER diagram
checklist.description: docs/entity_model.md contains a Mermaid erDiagram block. The diagram shows ONLY entity names and relationships — no attributes or column lists inside the entity blocks

checklist.name: AIUP data types
checklist.description: Entity attribute tables in docs/entity_model.md use only AIUP type vocabulary (Long, String, Integer, Decimal, Boolean, Date, DateTime) — does NOT contain SQL types such as VARCHAR, bigint, Decimal(10,2), @db.Decimal, or TEXT

checklist.name: Five-column attribute tables
checklist.description: Each entity section in docs/entity_model.md has a table with exactly 5 columns: Attribute, Description, Data Type, Length/Precision, Validation Rules

checklist.name: No endpoint-named use cases
checklist.description: No use case is named after a controller class, HTTP method, or route path (e.g., names like 'POST /orders', 'OrderController', 'deleteOrder' are absent)

checklist.name: Business rules numbered
checklist.description: At least one use case spec contains a Business Rules section with at least one rule assigned a BR-XXX identifier
